It is confirmed by receipt of frequency-orbital resource in plans for broadcast and fixed satellite services, activity of National Space Agency of Ukraine in creation of NSSC space segment

articleTitle: Signal Processing in Coherent Systems for Monitoring the Surrounding Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The application of coherent radiation for monitoring the gas in atmosphere is developed. The ambiguity of measurements could be excluded by combining the system with more rough measuring tool with single-valued detection performance

articleTitle: The Spectrum of Current Oscillations of Gunn Diodes with the Impact Ionization in Moving Domains
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the numerical simulation of the GaAs Gunn diode with electric field strengths, sufficient for development of the impact ionization in the moving high-field domains, are presented. The form of current oscillations and frequency spectrums is in good agreement with experimentally measured data. It is shown that the Gunn diode operating under conditions of the impact ionization may be used as a source of wide spectrum UHF-noise

articleTitle: Electronic Training Management
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report includes the comparative analysis of existing platforms of the training management used both for remote, and for traditional training with the brief review of their opportunities, advantages and lacks for revealing the optimum decision at a choice of a platform

articleTitle: The Influence of «Lacing» Interface Positions on I-V Characteristics for RTD Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of "lacing" interface positions on I-V characteristics of double-barrier resonant tunneling diodes (RTD) was investigated using two-band combined model

articleTitle: Specific features of the rating system of the knowledge level estimate
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Specific features of the rating system for knowledge assessment have been considered. Possible variants of the rating system have been shown, along with brief characteristics and drawbacks. It is recommended to apply "hard" rating for maximum stimulation of educational process.

articleTitle: Digital Signature in Modern Informational Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of modern cryptosystems is carried out, their advantages and disadvantages are exposed. On their basis the own system of electronic digital signature (EDS) was developed. It corresponds to the existing standards. It does not require any hardware or software improvements and it can be applied on the ordinary PC. The EDS is designed for operation in any telecommunication network for protecting of the transmitted information from falsification or modification. This system was realized on C++ programming language and can be used on PC with any version of Windows

articleTitle: Image Fusion in Wideband Passive Satellite Monitoring Systems based on Multilevel Approach
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new data fusion technique for multichannel remote sensing satellite systems is suggested, whose properties have been verified using the data received via the Landsat 7 ETM+ satellite. The principal advantage of this technique, confirmed by comparisons at the data level between systems with or without data fusion, is the application of a multilevel approach to the data fusion problem

articleTitle: Web-System Interface Prototype Designing
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper is detailed description of Web-system interface prototype designing, its logical stages that form the integral and complete part of the whole Web-system, as the particular case of informational system (IS) designing. The article includes the proposed methodology for IS development, some specific principles, that are typical for this sphere of scientific researches, software solutions, made as the result of real experiment and got results. The designed software tools are also represented in the article

articleTitle: K-Band Waveguide Bragg Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility for controlling band-gap parameters of Bragg structure at variation of its period has been shown. Periodic dielectric structures have been proposed to be used as waveguide filters of mm, sub-mm and THz ranges with different frequency characteristics

articleTitle: An Eigen Q-Factor of Electromagnetic Modes in Semi-Opened Waveguide Junctions of Various Configurations with Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The electrodynamic and numerical analysis of eigen Q-factor of electromagnetic modes of H-type (as the most high-quality) in waveguide junction of cylindrical-rectangular waveguides filled by dielectric have been carried out in this work. The comparative characteristic of eigen Q-factor waveguide junctions of various cross-section was given: cylindrical-radial waveguides, rectangular-rectangular waveguides, cylindrical-rectangular waveguides. The recommendations on using of a specific type of waveguide junctions for measurement of dielectric losses of the certain materials were given

articleTitle: Voltage-Controlled Synchronized FET Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simple method for control of output power of FET-oscillators by changing the supply voltage of an active element when using the scheme with synchronized oscillator has been proved theoretically and experimentally

articleTitle: Experimental Definition of Dipole Resonator Polarizability
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the technique for calculation of magnetic and electric polarizability of dipole resonators using experimental results. It was determined good coincidence between the measured and calculated polarization values, that proves the technique correctness.

articleTitle: Radiation Induced Limitation of Optical Fiber Capacity
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Limitation of optical fibers capacity by ionizing radiation loads is discussed. Analysis of noise generated within optical fibers by external factors presents significant scientific and practical interest. Among external factors the ionizing radiation represents the special interest because of multiplicity of phenomena generated within a fiber. As a result of irradiation both dielectric and mechanical parameters of a fiber are changed. Due to these effects destructive phase phenomena will arise in an optical signal propagating in a fiber

articleTitle: Dynamics of Motor System Functional State During Microwave Resonance Therapy
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the researches regarding the functional state of patients with osteoarthrosis and their psycho-emotional state during microwave resonance therapy (MRT) are presented. The researches have been conducted using estimation scales, clinical and paraclinical methods. Remote functional results of MRT have been traced. It is concluded that MRT affects the patients' psycho-emotional regardless of pathological process weight

articleTitle: Singularities of Creation of the Broadband Radio Access Networks on the Basis of Wimax Technology
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Features of construction of a broadband radio access networks are submitted on the basis of the WiMAX technology equipment, including technology features, networks directivity, functional requirements to them and architecture of networks construction

articleTitle: Estimation of Coherent Signal Phase Shift Inside the Enviroment with Acoustic Variations
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Application of coherent optical radiation to create high sensitive remote measuring devices of environment density is considered. The estimation in this paper provides the change of a phase during light modulation by sound waves, which provides high sensitivity of measurement. This leads to a conclusion on possible application considered phase method for measurement the parameter variations of surroundings with high accuracy

articleTitle: Subminiature Oscillator Modules for Millimeter-Wave Therapy and Technology for their Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the unique design and engineering solutions, which have made it possible to create subminiature oscillator modules for millimeter-wave therapy. The feasibility of the electroforming-based manufacturing and assembly of quasimonolithic waveguide devices without butt joints is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Simulation of Islands Size Influence on IV-Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper are simulation results of single-electron 2D arrays using physical models for various islands number

articleTitle: Educational Technologies in the Higher Pedagogical School System
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The opportunities of educational technologies in the system of upbringing of teachers are considered in this article

articleTitle: Study of Mechanical Attenuator Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Study results of mechanical attenuator characteristics of LtknifeGt and cylinder types are given. It is shown that while attenuation control from 0 till 20 dB, cylinder attenuator phase change is 2 or 3 times less

articleTitle: 34 Mbit/s RRL Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the possibility of creating inexpensive 34 Mbit/s and more RRL on the basis of assemblies applied in satellite TV systems. It enables to save time at the stage of development and adjustment.

articleTitle: Approximation for Regularity of Distribution Probability of Speech Signals' Amplitudes
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The probability distribution law approximations for the criteria of maximal accuracy, simplicity of expressions, and minimal time of calculations are studied. The problem of determination of the distribution law for probability of readout of amplitudes of a speech signal in view of a modern technological level of measuring engineering is important. Other important problem is development of rather precise mathematical model of the law of the distribution obtained experimentally. Thus, the purpose of the given work is the selection of new approximation for the law of distribution of probabilities of readout of amplitudes of a speech signal

articleTitle: Diversity Reception System
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is technical decision of increasing the distance of RRL signals transmission using space diversity reception system.

articleTitle: Electric Field Distribution in A Backlash of the Coaxial Resonator of A Microwave Microscope
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Numerical model of a microwave microscope is brought. On the basis of the given model the calculation of electric fields in section of the coaxial resonator that is a part of a microwave microscope is made.

articleTitle: The Layered Hemispherical Resonator for Dielectrometry
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The characteristic equation for complex frequencies of layered dielectric resonator was obtained. The eigenfrequencies and Q-factors depending on diameter of inner layer at the presence of different substances are presented.

articleTitle: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of Heterostructures on the Basis of III-V Materials for UHF Transistors
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described is MBE technology, whose essence is the growth of heterostructures for UHF transistors including nitride technology. We demonstrate that buffer layer optimization allows improving GaAs FETs parameters. Procedures of AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs heterostructures growth for PHEMT, as well as the heterostructures themselves, have been also optimized. Presented in this paper is the data on MBE technology development, especially as regards GaN/AlGaN heterostructures with two-dimensional electronic gas for HEMT

articleTitle: Non-Heme Iron Metabolism Indexes in Newborn Infants of Various Gestational Age in Early Neonatal Period
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Iron, a basic component of human cells and tissues, is involved in transportation of oxygen and electrons, destruction of peroxidates, oxidative phosphorylation, porphyrin metabolism, collagen synthesis, action of lymphocytes and granulocytes. The bulk of iron is transferred from mother to fetus antenatally during the second half of pregnancy and its quantity mostly depends on the pregnancy course and duration. It is concluded that metabolism of non-heme iron in premature infants has its specific features associated with premature birth which cannot but affect subsequent variations in the postnatal metabolism of iron resulting in iron deficiency and asiderotic anemia

articleTitle: On reliability of Applied level with Opportunity of MPLS Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Reliability calculation of an applied level of MPLS network (multiprotocol label switching) is carried out on the basis of the semi-Markov device processes, taking into account an opportunity of reconfiguration and phase integration of a network in general

articleTitle: Double Zone Bandstop Filter on Dielectric Resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new class filter that include two separate subsystem coupling high-Q cylindrical dielectric resonators (DR) in the rectangular waveguide have been examined. Proposed structure has minimal dimensions and allows realizing two independent rejection bands at the same time

articleTitle: Influence of Constant and Revolving Magnetic Field on Viability of Drosophila at Embryonic Stage and on Chromatin State in Human Cells
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Classification of Foreign Radio Frequency Connectors for Microwave Electronics
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Classification of foreign radio frequency connectors for microwave electronics is presented. The main types of connectors are considered. The main parameters of connectors are given in tables. Frequency range for different connectors with impedance 50 Ω makes up from DC up to 110 GHz.

articleTitle: Videosignal Retranslator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: 1 kHz÷16 GHz Wavemeter
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Features and design of microwave data-processing wavemeters FMD-012 and FMD-012H for continuous harmonic waves are discussed.

articleTitle: Single-Frequency Tunable Laser for Caesium Frequency Standard
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: 10, 5, 3, 2 Centimeter Wave Length Band High Power Transistors of R&PC «Istok»
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A series of high output power hermetically sealed, internally matched FETs for 10, 5, 3, 2 cm wave length band with output power higher than 10, 10, 5, 5 W, associated gain higher than 8, 7, 6 and 5 dB correspondently has been developed. FETs are designed for both continuous and pulse operation.

articleTitle: Inverse Problem of Scattering in Scanning Near-Field Tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new tomography method of the inhomogeneous half-space is proposed that can be realized in the scanning probe microscopy and other kinds of electromagnetic diagnostics of media. In this method the 2D scanning of variations of the signal related to inhomogeneities in a medium are in use. The scanning should be done at various values of a parameter that determines the effective depth of the formation of the received signal

articleTitle: 800 MHz and 1035 MHz UHF Class E Power Amplifiers on CLY5 MESFET
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two UHF Class E power amplifiers were designed, simulated, and fabricated with operating frequencies 800 MHz and 1035 MHz, respectively. The high efficiency DC-AC power conversion in power amplifier (PA) was obtained using class E mode operation

articleTitle: Radio Absorption Materials on the Basis of Filled Polymers
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio absorption materials on the basis of polymeric technologies are designed. Considered in this paper are the absorption parameters of three types of the polymeric materials filled by metallic soft magnetic materials, which are broadly applicable in radio electronic equipment

articleTitle: L-Xc-Band Dielectric Resonator Filters for High Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles and results of the design of microwave band-pass filters on dielectric resonators (DR) for high level (over 100 W) signals are discussed. Filters have insertion losses less than 1.2 dB at 2.6 % passband, 6.25 % passband at 90 dB level and spurious passband suppression over 60 dB

articleTitle: EHF-Therapy Equipment
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the history of development of EHF-therapy equipment. The basic tendencies in development of perspective equipment are discussed.

articleTitle: The Ideology of Special Ukrainian Digital Information Transmission Systems' Creation
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of evolution known concepts generalization of special digital information transmission systems (SDITS) and experience of writers in the field of the digital communication problems of construction Ukrainian SDITS, including command problems, for the state structures providing public and national safety are defined

articleTitle: Magnetostatic Resonance in Hybrid Planar Ubitron
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the linear approximation the dispersion relation for an arbitrary waveguide loaded with a thin electron beam moving in magnetic field of a hybrid planar ubitron is obtained. We have calculated the amplification band, spatial growth rate and carried out efficiency estimation taking into account conditions of magnetostatic resonance

articleTitle: Modern Requirements to the Education's Content in the Context of Bologna Process
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper is devoted to the main directions of High Education modernisation in the context of Bologna process. The positive and negative aspects, the important problems of High Education modernisation are discussed.

articleTitle: Quasioptical Hot Electron Bolom-Eter Mixers Based on Thin NBN Films for Terahertz Region
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the performances of HEB mixers based on 2-3.5 nm thick NbN films integrated with log-periodic spiral antenna. Double side-band receiver noise temperature values are 1300 K and 3100 K at 2.5 THz and at 3.8 THz, respectively. Mixer gain bandwidth is 5.2 GHz. Local oscillator power is 1-3 muW for mixers with different active area

articleTitle: Formation of the Creative Person of Teacher During Studying «Pedagogic» in Pedagogic University
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The definition "the creative person of the teacher" is formulated, parameters which characterize it are considered here. Detailed consideration of a course "Pedagogy" shows ways of formation of the creative person of the future teacher at all stages of studying. The resulted given examples from practice of teaching of "Pedagogics" give opportunity to use them by teachers of other high schools

articleTitle: Measuring Device for Field Maintenance of Radio Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper considers the measuring device designed and ready for production at Betatvcom Ltd. It is further design of multifunctional measuring device LFM-700

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Frequency Synthesizer for Millimeter Band Quasi-Optical ESR-Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper are the results of design of computer-aided frequency synthesizer for millimeter band quasi-optical ESR spectrometer. Adjusting of the output signal frequency is realized using reference digital synthesizer, which is controlled by computer or remote-control unit. The long-time frequency instability is not worse than 2*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup>; the minimal frequency step is 10 Hz. The operating characteristics of the synthesizer are demonstrated at the ESR-spectroscopic test measurements

articleTitle: Lossy Dielectrics Influence on Radiating Characteristics of Waveguide-Slot Antennas
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of lossy dielectrics inserted into slot volumes and lossy dielectric coating on radiating and directional characteristics of waveguide-slot antennas was investigated.

articleTitle: The Pyramidal Microwave Thermal Module
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of calculation of electrodynamics of the thermal module of a pyramidal design for the microwave drying and processing of dielectric absorbing materials are submitted

articleTitle: X-Band Power AlGaN/GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the results of design and manufacture of middle power X-band AlGaN/GaN HEMT are presented. It has Gain=11 dB, P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OUT </sub>=1.4 W/mm at F=10 GHz

articleTitle: Microwave Contactless Method to Measure the Nonequilibrium Carriers' Effective Lifetime in Si Wafers
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of contactless measurement of non-equilibrium carriers' (NEC) effective lifetime in Si wafers has been developed, it allows forming a map of NEC effective life-time surface distribution.

articleTitle: MDM Microwave Varactors based on Ferroelectric Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is design of metal-dielectric-metal (MDM) varactor based on ferroelectric thin film. Varactor equivalent circuit of is presented. Varactors microwave parameters are calculated and compared with experimental results

articleTitle: Bandpass Filters Design on the Basis of Phase Characteristic of Reflection Factor
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technique of design bandpass filters and optimization of their design factors is considered. Structures of the developed filters have been considered as an example.

articleTitle: Emission Time of Solar Noise Storm Radio Bursts
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of solar noise storms (NS) has shown that the total existence time and the energy of all short NS bursts with duration of 0.2-0.4 s are 5 times less than the total time and energy of longer bursts and contains only about 2-5 % of NS bursts energy. Thus, the measurement of emission time and burst energy do not confirm widespread opinion that NS consists of short-lived type I bursts

articleTitle: Packet Retransmission in Ad Hoc Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper considers the problems of packet delays when retransmissions occur in ad hoc networks. Multifrequency connections between subscribers-repeaters are suggested. When Ad hoc networks are analyzed, main attention is paid to routing and security. A multiple access protocol must be used in order to avoid or minimize packet collisions

articleTitle: Optimization of Harmonic Filter Performance on the Basis of a Rectangular Waveguide with Impedance Walls
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The performance of a harmonic filter has been calculated on the basis of a rectangular waveguide with impedance walls formed by lateral cylindrical waveguides coupled to the rectangular waveguide through edge slots. In the general case, the wall impedance is complex, which allows for losses to be taken into account in this filter.

articleTitle: The Microwaveheliospectrometer Acting Model with the Parallel Analysis of Rectified Signal
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Effects of different technological conditions on inhomogeneity of basic magnetic characteristics of thin cobalt films obtained with chemical deposition are investigated with ferromagnetic resonance method. articleTitle: X-Band MMIC Low Noise Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: A CAD Tool for Synthesis of Matching Networks Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A CAD tool, GENESYN is presented that allows the synthesis of lumped-element matching networks based on genetic algorithm (GA). Due to overall control over network configuration and element values, it generates practical and convenient networks. An example of designing interstage matching network for microwave transistor amplifier is demonstrated. Currently-available analytical and numerical matching network synthesis techniques have numerous limitations. Now, prospective genetic algorithms are often used for the structural synthesis of different technical systems. In this paper, a GA-based CAD tool for matching network synthesis is presented. The problem is to synthesize two-port network between complex-impedance source and the load providing prescribed transducer power gain (TPG) response over the passband. Network configurations are limited by lumped-element ladder-type circuits that can be represented as a connection of sections (series- or parallel-connected R-, C- and L-elements or resonant contours). In the paper, main steps of GA are described. Network configuration and elements are coded by binary string (chromosome). In this code, section type (series- or parallel), element type (R, C or L) and element value are represented by binary numbers of some length. GA imitates an evolution of living organisms in nature based on chromosome crossover, mutation and selection. Using GA, a CAD tool GENESYN for the synthesis of lumped-element matching networks is implemented. The advantage of GA-based procedure over existing synthesis techniques is the user control of network configuration and element values. GENESYN allows the generation of a set of matching network configurations.

articleTitle: The Automatic Generator of Super-High Frequencies with Optical Control
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigations of characteristics of the superhigh frequency oscillator are represented on the basis of transistor structure consisting of bipolar transistors of one type of admittance. The opportunity, both optical, and electric frequency control of generation, is shown. The expansion of a tuning frequency range of generation of self-excited oscillators of superhigh frequencies is one of major problems at their design. One of paths of the decision of this problem is the variation of equivalent capacity of a tuning circuit of UHF of the oscillator and dynamic negative resistance canceling power losses in the tuning circuit. The variation of these parameters is possible through action of optical radiation on a photosensitive diode switched on in a circuit of backward positive communication of the self-excited oscillator. On Fig. 1 the circuit of the self-excited oscillator is represented. It represents a hybrid integrated circuit consisting of three bipolar transistors, three resistors, capacity, inductance and photosensitive diode. Such circuit implements the self-excited oscillator of superhigh frequencies with optical frequency control of generation. The tuning circuit consists of inductance L1 and equivalent capacity of a complete resistance existing on electrodes of a collector and the emitter of the bipolar transistor VT2. The variation of power of optical radiation from 0 up to 120 uWt/cm2 reduces in a frequency change of generation on 70 MHz at supply voltage of 5 V. The greatest sensitivity makes 1.15 MHz/uWt/cm2 and lays in a range from 5 uWt/cm2 up to 60uWt/cm2.

abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of unsoldered electron gun design for transmitting broad ribbon electron beam into the atmosphere or other gas medium. The gun uses ribbon cathode 320times6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sup>, rectangular focusing electrode located near the cathode with slot holes on the edges of its wide side walls and anode as a hollow tube with rectangular cross-section, whose end is closed with a massive copper grid with 20 mum titanium foil fixed on it in order to transmit the beam from vacuum volume of the gun. The electrode shape and interelectrode spacings have been optimized using CAD, which allowed providing required current, homogeneous irradiation of the whole output window and homogeneous distribution of radiation doze behind the output window. The gun is designed to be used in technological installations for radiation processing of products and materials by beams of accelerated electrons

articleTitle: Antenna Assembly for Provision the Communication in the Regions Difficult to Access
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of design of subscriber's passive antenna for cellular communication systems are considered. Antennas assembly design and its basic specification were considered. Stable communication realization is performed by means of rebroadcasting transmitters (RT). They consist of two-directional amplifier and two antennas-internal and external.

articleTitle: Microwave System for Wireless Providing of Multimedia Services UMDS MITRIS
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is telecommunication system UMDS MITRIS, providing high-tech decision for wide-band distribution networks. It should be noted that UMDS MITRIS is consumer system, which takes into account perspectives of national information systems integrated into European and worldwide infrastructures. It is shown that system architecture provides its compatibility with broadcasting satellite systems, and can be supplied with micro-power retranslators and cable system, that allows widening the service area. Considered are performance criteria of wireless wideband access systems and perspectives for UMDS MITRIS system application.

articleTitle: The Efficiency Factor Uncertainty Estimate of Power Meters
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There is a method of power meters of accepted power uncertainty estimate observed. Frequency coefficient of microwave frequency power meter is number which depends on frequency. It's necessary to multiply frequency coefficient by observed value of power to determine the current power level

articleTitle: Modeling of the Heterostructure Field-Effect Transistor with Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Characteristics of the heterostructure transistor with quantum dots (QD) on the grounds of two-dimensional numerical model are presented

articleTitle: Contact Areas Influence on Quantum Wires Electric Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that under some conditions electric characteristics of quantum wire (QW) are completely determined by physical properties and topology of contact areas. New transistor types on the basis of QW are offered. Device is named "injection quantum transistor" (IQT). Current-voltage characteristics of IQT are calculated

articleTitle: H-Type Oscillations in Waveguide-Coaxial Resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The waveguide-coaxial resonator model (WCR) is presented and calculation procedure of the eigen frequencies and eigen Q-factors of the main electromagnetic oscillation H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11delta</sub> for this resonator is proposed. articleTitle: Deformations of Elements of the Reflecting Surfaces of the 70-Meter Antenna Installation Caused by Climatic Factors
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper considers influence of climatic factors on facets taken separately of the mirror system of the antenna installation of the 70-meter antenna SM-214 AU (Crimea, Ussuriysk), i.e. formation of temperature fields from climatic factors (solar radiation, convection, night cooling) and influence of temperature fields on distortion of the reflecting surface form

articleTitle: Flexible Technology for the Intellectual Information Processing Software Design
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the flexible technology for the intellectual information processing software design is proposed. This technology consists of three parts: support system, designing and development system, information bases, and enables to adapt to different application domain by the one-time data binding

articleTitle: Distribution of an Electromagnetic Field of Eigen Oscillations in A Radially Two-Layered Resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The eigen oscillations of radially two-layered cylindrical dielectric resonator bounded by twice perfect conductive flat end surfaces are studied. The numerical researches were carried out for a resonator with internal layer filled by substances with different complex permittivity. The distribution of an electromagnetic field of eigen oscillation along a radius of a resonator is shown. The influence of permittivity value and loss tangent of internal layer on field distribution of eigen oscillation of a resonator is shown

articleTitle: Application of Pendulum Swing Model for Explanation of Radiowaves Backscattering from Biological Objects in SHF and HF Wavebands
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the model considering biological object motion, which allows explaining the peculiarities of scattered signals spectra, which are caused by their frequency modulation are proposed. The approach proposed allows formulating information features in order to distinguish reflection from human and animals

articleTitle: Compact Autonomous Repetitively Pulsed Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is a compact pulsed oscillator powered by high voltage source for up to 320 kV with pulse repetition frequency control from single-pulse mode up to 40 Hz. Radiator of Hertz dipole type was used as a load.

articleTitle: Chaotic Dynamics in Millimetre-Wave Gunn Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of Axial Forming Systems of Electronic Beams
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical analysis results of two modifications of axial-symmetric electron-optical systems with converging optics based upon previously developed algorithm are presented. The information on a structure and distribution of current density of an electronic bunch taking into account settling on electrodes is obtained

articleTitle: Field Fluctuations in Fresnel Zone of Circular Aperture with Random Phase Errors
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Effects of random phase errors on amplitude and phase field fluctuations in Fresnel zone of the focused circular aperture are considered. Results obtained are suitable for different mechanisms of the fluctuation origins. These results are useful in estimation of actual performance for different focusing systems used in radio engineering, optics, acoustics, in justification the reasonable requirements for tolerances, stability of component parameters of mentioned systems

articleTitle: Diagnostics of the Body Condition by Thermal Fields Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, to form requirements for the methods of temperature measurements of biological objects (BO), human body behavior as a dynamic open system has been observed based on stability theory

articleTitle: Basic Problems and Development of Satellite Telecommunication Technology in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the analysis of satellite telecommunications modern state. It is necessary to create National System of Satellite Communication (NSSC). Proposed is the project of NSSC creation.

articleTitle: Spatially Distributed Multi-Probe System in Phased Array Measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Specific issues of applying a spatially distributed multi-probe system in phased array measurements allowing for faster and more accurate alignment and assessment are examined. The measurement system uses spatially distributed probes with a phase shift to isolate signals in each channel against the background of the measured total signal in order to facilitate measurements and overcome design and process limitations. While implementing such systems, special attention should be paid to issues related to calibration and monitoring of multi-channel probe and to algorithms of the controlled channel signal isolation, including proper location and number of probe antennas, transfer matrix calibration, development and proper application of normalizing coefficients. The available results show that the application of the spatially distributed multi-probe system in the alignment and testing of phased array antennas provides increased accuracy along with time and cost savings.

articleTitle: Unlocal Heat Generation Picualitiers in High Power Submicrometer Gate FET'S
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simple model for heat generation area size depending on transistor topology and active layers properties is developed. It is shown that real heat generation area size is much less than transistor structure period and the gate drain distance. By three — dimension modeling it is shown that taking into account real heat generation area size raised estimated channel temperature by 10 — 30°C.

articleTitle: Calculation of Electron Mobility in Thin Undoped GaAs Quantum Wires
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The dependencies of electron mobility in thin undoped GaAs quantum wires on the lattice temperature and surface roughness correlation length have been calculated at the electric quantum limit using Monte Carlo method. All the dominant scattering mechanisms of charge carriers in GaAs quantum wires are taken into account in considered case. The scatterers are polar optical phonons, surface phonons, acoustic phonons and surface roughness. Moreover, it is taken into account the collisional broadening (electron energy uncertainty) and the nonparabolicity in the dispersion relation between the wave vector and kinetic energy of charge carriers while calculating particles scattering rate and simulation of their transportation in the electric field

articleTitle: Promotion of Creativity and Solution of Complicated Scientific-and-Engineering Problems using Knowledge Transplantation Method
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is suggested to use knowledge transplantation method for students' creative abilities promotion and for solution of complicated scientific-and-engineering problems

articleTitle: Simulation of GaAs/AlGaAs RTD using One-Band Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are investigations regarding the influence of doping concentration in RTD barriers and on IV-characteristics. One-band combined RTD model is based on semiclassical and quantum-mechanical (the wave-function formalism) approaches. It takes into account the effect of charge in different regions, including surface charge at heterointerfaces, the shape of band offsets, scattering in the quantum well, and resistances of extended passive regions. In order to describe the barrier and quantum well shapes, hyperbolic approximation has been used. publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Oscillations of Whispering Gallery in the Open Cylindrical Resonator Raised by the Capacitor Crack
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of excitement of the fluctuations of whispering galleries with the capacitive slot in the open cylindrical resonator is considered. The structure of the field is explored and a location of the element supply of the resonator is optimized. The obtained results are of interest for development of devices for natural gas humidity measurements

articleTitle: Polarizationary-Spectral Objects Selection on the SEA Surface Background
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility for increasing efficiency of surface objects selection using polarizationary spectral features of scattered signals on orthogonal polarizations is shown

articleTitle: Optimal Representation of Signals to be Transmitted
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of optimal (in terms of minimum root-mean-square error) representation of signals in the finite-dimensional basis has been solved by determining the orthogonality weight of the basis functions. Basis functions are represented by minimum-phase equidistant functions having amplitude spectrum equal to the amplitude-frequency characteristic of communication channel accurate to the constant factor. Deterministic signals can be optimally described by a few different bases each having weight function being dependent on types of signals transmitted and basis functions. There is only one way in order to determine the basis for optimal definition of the random signal, with the weight function being dependent on the basis functions and signal covariance

articleTitle: Measurements of Small Doppler Frequency Shifts using Microwave Homodyne Velocimeters
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper discusses principles of measuring small velocities using Doppler techniques.

articleTitle: Microwave Measurement of Highloss Liquid Permittivity Insmall Volume
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New measurement permittivity method of high loss liquid in small volume using semi-spherical microwave resonator with small central cavity for measuring liquid was worked out

articleTitle: Solidstate Spectromter of Subteraherz Frequency with Use of Frequency Multiplier based on Quantum Semiconductor Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The creation opportunity of a subTHz range spectrometer for precision, non-stationary spectroscopy (with registration of a signal in time area) is shown on the basis of solid-state sources of radiation and multiplication of frequency with use of quantum semi-conductor superlattices.

articleTitle: Irradiation Induced Aberrations in Spaceborne Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for evaluating irradiation induced aberrations in space optical systems is discussed. articleTitle: A Microwave Radiometry Technique for Dynamic Monitoring of Thermoregulation System Using RT-01 `Natalka' Radio Thermometer
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A dynamic monitoring of thermoregulation system has been carried out, involving monitoring of metabolism in tissues and muscles, with the use of a microwave radio thermometry technique

articleTitle: Video Surveillance Systems for Moving Object
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Interaction of Fuzzy Dynamic Cognitive Training Models with Lingvological Preference Pattern Models
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Isomorphous transformation of fuzzy cognitive maps into the models of decision making preference systems has been developed. System algorithms are illustrated by information strategies simulation.

articleTitle: Vacancies in Nanotubes and Fullerenes
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Within the limits of a method of the molecular mechanics of MM+models of vacancies in carbon nanotubes by diameters 0.82 and 1.20 nm, and also in the some fullerenes are developed. Geometrical optimization of the gained molecular models were spent by algorithms of the steepest descent etc. Calculations of energy of nanostructures were carried out by the extended Huckel method. articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Control P-I-N-Devices

Experimental parameters and characteristics of the components in the operating frequency band are given

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Two Centimeter Wave Length Band High Power Pulse Solid-State Amplifier of R&PC «ISTOK»
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: High power pulse solid-state hybrid amplifier has been developed for two centimeter wavelength band. Applied at module design have been all HF components of R&PC «Istok». publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: A Software System for EMC Analysis of Co-Sited Equipment
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) assessment of co-sited facilities is one the most important issues to be addressed when laying out electronic equipment in the areas where antennas or other electronic facilities have been already deployed. Assessment of the on-site EMC involves extensive calculations and is performed using a dedicated software system designed at Military Unit A 0375. This software system is intended to calculate possible mutual influence of electronic facilities located within restricted spaces. It may be used to assess potential interference in receivers resulting from blocking and intermodulation, while direct interference in the main receiver channel is absent. To resolve the problem of assessing the EMC for co-sited facilities, certain initial data should be provided about the receiver under investigation and a group of interference-emitting transmitters. After calculations have been completed, the following data is displayed: - interference levels at antenna inputs, RF filter and amplifier inputs; - total interference level at the RF amplifier input, which is used as indicator of blocking interference; - levels of intermodulation products in the main and image receiver channels; - summarized calculations. This software systems has the following advantages compared to similar foreign and local products: - modular design; - network installation allowing for EMC to be calculated at several workstations simultaneously using the same database; - superior price/performance ratio. This software system has been extensively used enabling much faster EMC calculations for co-sited facilities.

articleTitle: Specific Features of Electron Beam Interaction with Electromagnetic Wave in Diffraction Radiation Mode
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Exact Reciprocal Formulation for Rigorous Modeling of Broadband Waveguide Bolometric Systems in Transmitting Mode
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Microwave Microelectronic Devices based on Artificial Transmission Lines with Negative Dispersion
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Expansion of the Application Fields and Development Perspectives of Meteor Burst Radio Communication and Synchronization

articleTitle: Generators-Frequency Multipliers for Millimeter and Submillimeter Wavelengths Range
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

It is shown, that the calculated electron efficiency of orbotron-klystrons on frequencies 50-300 GHz reaches up to 16-54%. Output power of klystron-frequency multipliers reaches 2.6-39 W on frequencies of 500-2000 GHz

articleTitle: Magnetic Separator of Electrons for Gyrodevices with Multistage Depressed Collector
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

The separation of the electron beam energy fractions in the collector region is organized by the installation of the ferromagnetic ring coaxial to the main solenoid. This may increase the efficiency of the energy recovery for gyrodevices with the multistage depressed collector.

articleTitle: The Influence of Residual Gases Ionization on the Virtual Cathode Dynamics in the Low-Voltage Vircator
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Influence of Directional Pattern Real Shape on Long-Distance Tro-Pospheric Propagation
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Matching Networks Etched on High Dielectric Constant Substrates for Power MESFET Modeling
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of simulation of matching networks for power MESFET's. The technique of modeling is based on substitution of coupled microstrip by equivalent single microstrip placed inside magnet field webs. The designated power MESFET has L - C - L type matching networks. The lumped capacitors were realized as parallel plate capacitors on 0.3mm thick ceramic substrates, which have high dielectric constant. The inductors were approximated by bond wires. The distance between microstrip lines on ceramics is equal 40 microns that causes the strong coupling between them. Modeling of scheme with coupling lines has hard mathematic problems. This problem is solved by replacement of the coupled lines by the equivalent single lines. The wave impedance and slowness factor have been defined for a single microstrip line located between magnetic walls. This approach allows us to take into account a coupling of microstrip lines at designing a matching networks of power transistor.

articleTitle: High Quantum Efficiency of Intersubband Transision on Combined Parity Levels in Triple-Barrier Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Exact analytical steady-state solution of the time-dependence Schrödinger equations at resonance in hf electric field of finite amplitude is found as well as expression for hf active conductivity. It is shown that if the energy levels in each quantum well which form the common resonance level of the whole structure have the different parity, the common resonance level width and integral hf structure conductance can rise many times and quantum efficiency of radiative transitions between dimensionally quantized levels can be up to 80 %. Respectively, the electron life time in structure fall many times, so the conditions for electron to leave the structure without electron-phonon collision can be simply realized, and one has the real way for realization of ballistic electron transport quantum-cascade laser.

articleTitle: Full-Cycle System Realization for Microwave Stripline CAD in LambdaMDS

articleTitle: Modeling of Multiple Two-Layer Cylindrical Posts in A Rectangular Waveguide

articleTitle: Autodyne Radar Detecting the Motion Direction of Reflecting Objects
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are three versions of technical decision for autodyne radar, which provide the opportunity to measure simultaneously the velocity of objects motion and to detect the direction of their relative movement. The radar includes combined antenna connected to autodyne transmit-receive module with frequency conversion and decoupling wideband transformer, IF signal amplifier, frequency discriminator, amplitude detector, phase comparator and frequency counter. articleTitle: Quantum Medicine and Age-Related Pathology
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibilities of implementing quantum medicine technologies in treating elderly (60-74 years) and senile (75-89 years) patients under various clinical presentations are discussed. Prospects of further quantum medicine applications in gerontology are considered

articleTitle: Noise Model of Thermionic Cathode
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Harmonic Balance Technique in Context of Functional Hardware Verification
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes problems related to verification of communication systems and demonstrates approach of digital and harmonic balance co-simulation. Functional verification has become major component of digital hardware designs. Usage of analog behavioral models and co-simulation allows end-to-end simulation and verification of digital communication links. Simulation speed and ability to represent relevant design details are of paramount importance for simulation tools for RF/MW. Third distinct feature is usage of wide spread languages like VHDL-AMS or Verilog-AMS for analog part modeling

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Gate Design and Influence on PHEMT Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dependence of pHEMT drain current on gate recession (etching depth of heteroepitaxial structure) is investigated. Relation between the level of drain current left before gate evaporation, transconductance and gate recession proceeding from features and physics of pHEMT is established. The influence of initial drain current magnitude on transistor microwave parameters is established. Thus, achievement of high microwave parameters of the device is possible provided the optimal choice of initial drain current proceeding from layer configuration of semiconductor structure.

articleTitle: Electronic Course for the Distance Education on the Communication Systems CAD

publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

The method was suggested and is based on nonlinear processing of two different SAR images generated from the same raw data. One of these images is SAR image with low sidelobes while the second one has Ltarray blindnessGt at the target direction. articleTitle: Electromagnetic Waves in Artificial Periodic Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Periodical structures are particularly interesting in the optical and near-optical frequency range and may be used to manufacture electronic circuits, devices and unusual optical equipment. In some plates, waves at low incidence angles do not penetrate artificial media, while with increasing incidence angles waves begin to penetrate such media. At the same time, refraction angles decrease at first and subsequently change their sign. A plate may be designed where effects of birefringence are used: however, polarization of both rays is the same, as opposed to regular birefringence. In ferrite films placed into magnetic fields, reflected waves may be absent or no refracted waves be observed, although incident waves may be present

articleTitle: Bifilar Cylindrical Helical Irradiator for Spherical Reflector Antenna
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

One possibility to increase the operation area on spherical mirror surface under operation with irradiator proposed is shown

articleTitle: Longitudinal Synthetic Aperture Bistatic Radiometer for the Earth Surface Observation
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the new concept of a two-satellite radiometer for 2-D imaging from space. The performances of this instrument are evaluated in terms of angular/spatial resolution and radiometric sensitivity. The L-band bistatic radiometer illustrative example is presented

articleTitle: Markov Chains for Solving the Telecommunication Networks Protection Task
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the method providing telecommunication networks security on the basis of variable length Markov chains is proposed. The prediction suffix tree was built for every user by modified algorithm. Tree sizes are varied depending on behavior regularity and the number of commands used

articleTitle: Quasioptical Resonant System for Semiconductor Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The open resonator loaded on the section of the oversize coaxial waveguide has been described and analyzed. This resonator can be used as an oscillation system for solid-state microwave and millimeter wave generators

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Foot-Passenger Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of the two-parameter dynamic foot-passenger model formed by five scattering centers, corresponding to his hands, foots and body, is carried out. The dependence of energy spectrum shape upon the motion velocity of foot-passenger, phase-frequency modulation indexes and signal processing time is investigated. It is shown that the optimal observation time for identification of dynamic radiolocating objects is a small part of the modulating signal cycle.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Coding Pseudorandom Algorithms on Basis of Coding Group Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For evaluation of effectiveness of application coding algorithms in telecommunication systems the analysis method for distribution of intervals between of identical coding groups' appearances in pseudorandom sequence and was detected a connection of this one with structure of the forming these sequence algorithm was propose

articleTitle: Provision Electromagnetic Safety at Realization the Antenna Measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main items of procedure for the antenna measurements of a radiated power are presented. The beamca antenna with dielectric lens over the range 25.86-37.5 GHz with a narrow directional diagram is developed. At realization the antenna measurements a radiation zone appears, it is necessary to know a level of an electromagnetic radiation with the purpose of provision of safety operation conditions in its neighborhood

articleTitle: Features of Semiconductor High-Stable Microwave Generators Design
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the results of experimental research of highly stable SHF-generator designed using stabilizing (basic) resonator, based on band-reflecting filter circuit are presented. It is shown that in order to prevent spectrum distortion at mechanical loadings (vibrations) it is necessary to compromise between Q-factor and the influence of specified disorganization factors

articleTitle: Microstrip Sensors for Local Measuring Surface Resistance on Microwaves
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two constructions of microstrip sensors are described, whose operation is based on interaction of high-frequency magnetic field generated by a measuring hole with a material under investigation. The influence of sensors' structure parameters on their sensitivity is investigated

articleTitle: Low-Current Gunn Diodes for Millimeter-Wave Therapy
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of development, creation and characterization of millimeter-wave Gunn diodes, which have made it possible to create subminiature oscillator modules for millimeter-wave therapy. A technology for creation of high-efficiency and high-reliability diodes is presented, which considerably improves devices performance and extends their functional capabilities.

articleTitle: Output Current and Dynamic Model of Photomultiplier Cathode Camera in the Electronic Microwave Mixer Regime
publicationTitle: 2006 16th International Crimean Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dynamic model of photomultiplier cathode camera is theoretically proved for the case when microwave electromagnetic field (LO field) is produced in the close vicinity of cathode area. It has been proved that the interaction of photocathode current with microwave heterodyne field can be modeled by the process in vacuum diode, in which the distance between the electrodes depends on the heterodyne voltage magnitude
